acceptance_gates.detail: Official URL, retrieval timestamp, ZIP hash/size, feed version/date range, and relevant row counts recorded.
Validated location_type=1 direct-prefix parents with source hierarchy and resolved scheduled child events.
Final panel has exactly 50 unique parent-station IDs.
Script version, fixed policy order, exposed lexicographic key, and geographic-cell parameters recorded.
Every selected row carries measured static evidence and a selection reason.
Every current core mode with evidence is represented and measured; zero-evidence modes are not invented.
Fixed-cell coverage, concentration counts, nearby retained pairs, and central/Deutz/Mülheim diagnostics recorded.
All seven current Legacy7 identities remain valid and are retained.
Bounded one-request-per-final-station diagnostic completed with sanitized classifications.
Membership is fixed after approval; changes require a new version with effective time, reason, and predecessor.
SelectionRank is a panel rank only; no Tier A/B/C cadence, NumberOfResults, concurrency, retry, or overlap decision was made.
Stage 13 production scheduler/collector activation and Stage 14 cutover remain NOT STARTED; existing readiness notes remain blocked.
Only sanitized evidence is written; MDD raw responses and API key are not persisted.

approved_stage4_semantics.parent_station_rule: location_type=1 parent; child membership from actual parent_station hierarchy

candidate_population.membership_rule: stop_id parent_station reference to location_type=1 source parent; child stop IDs also pass the direct Cologne prefix rule

geographic_concentration_review.coordinate_use: Secondary diversity diagnostics only; source identity is established from validated stop_id and hierarchy first.
geographic_concentration_review.finding: The panel uses a fixed-cell secondary spread pass and retains nearby stations when their source parent identities and scheduled service evidence are distinct; no name or coordinate was used to establish Cologne membership.
